I think we should do this outside the callback (that way you also dont need the check on line 85). It can take a thresholds arg that callback may populate, else default thresholds value.

It's not support with Sensor base class. Sensor class initializes all dbus-sensor interfaces (including thresholds interface) and also populates those interfaces with threshold value during the call to `setInitialProperties`. If we populated threshold later we have to call this function later but then sensor value won't be updated meanwhile as Sensor.Value interface won't be initialized until call to that function and it would result into error log each time we try to update the sensor value.
